MyoD degradation is mediated by the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway, that this process is preceded by ubiquitination and that the ubiquitination occurs at the N-terminal residue.
MyoD degradation is regulated by specific DNA binding and is mediated by the ubiquitin-proteasome system.

a novel pathway of MyoD degradation, regulated by DNA binding.
the ubiquitin-mediated degradation of MyoD and the underlying regulatory mechanism involved.
elucidation of the mechanisms involved in the degradation of transcription factors.
